correctness.rationale: A bijection maps each valid labelled cyclic colouring to exactly one closed walk on 35 compatible ordered column pairs. The explicit potential yields nonnegative reduced costs on all 70 arcs and proves lower bound n; zero-cost closed walks are precisely the weight-n optima. The exact 35-by-35 characteristic polynomial and its independently decomposed two recurrent blocks yield the claimed n-th trace. Standalone direct vertex enumeration (n=3..7), independent column DP (n=3..11), and exact trace (n=1..40) were replayed from the delivered source. Finite checks supplement rather than replace the general finite-state proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2023 article gives an all-n minimum-weight law via tropical traces; this weaker scalar conclusion does not imply the enumerator or number of minimizing assignments. The 2025 complementary-prism study concerns another graph construction.

value.rationale: The known minimum weight n does not imply a count of optimal assignments. The new exact multiplicity is exponential with a subdominant complex-conjugate correction and a four-divisibility correction, explained by a 12-state recurrent transition class and an isolated directed 4-cycle. It quantifies degeneracy and deployment choices of a natural infinite graph family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
